_source.dataset: HUD Qualified Census Tracts (QCTs) and Difficult Development Areas (DDAs) for the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit, 26 U.S.C. 42(d)(5)(B)
_source.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, Office of Policy Development and Research (HUD User)

2027.quote: The 2027 lists of QCTs and DDAs are effective: (1) for allocations of credit after December 31, 2026
2027.note: the same quote is the designation_effective_date row in housing_funding_rules.json

_source.scope: Every 2020 census tract and ZCTA that holds a station-area site's point (app/data/station_site_places). 544 sites lie over a county line from the county file that lists them; their own county is used.

zctas_columns: 2026 metropolitan Small DDA flag from HUD's sheet (1/0; null = ZCTA not on HUD's metro sheet)
HUD's own 2027-sheet column 'LIHTC Maximum Rent (1/12 of 30% of 120% of VLIL)' (USD per month; from the 2026 4-person VLIL), kept as a check of the rent formula
_source.how_to_read: QCT lists name tracts; a tract absent from HUD's list is not a QCT. A tract is in this table only if a site's point lies in it. A metropolitan site is in a DDA when its ZCTA's flag is 1. A ZCTA not on HUD's metro sheet (null) is not determined.
